ko: 그 무엇도 그 계획 흔들 수 없죠
en: From the very beginning, Your plan was for me,
and nothing could ever take that plan away

ko: 그 무엇도 그 사랑 흔들 수 없죠
en: From the very beginning, Your love was for me,
and nothing could ever take that love away

ko: 나 이제 알아요 내 삶의 이유를
나 따라갈래요 내 삶 주님께 드릴래요
en: I now have found the reason for my life, I will follow, I will give my life to You
The One who spread out the heavens my Father, The One who stretched out the seas my Father

ko: 그 누가 나를 흔들 수 있으랴
en: I am a child of the Lord who can ever shake me?

ko: 그 사랑 누가 끊을 수 있으랴
en: I am a child of the Lord who can ever break His love from me?
I am a child of the Lord, forever I belong to Him
Though the road I walk is rough, still my soul will sing
For true peace in the Lord fills my soul completely The One who spread out the heavens
